title: A wallet screen is a view of money records
description: A wallet dashboard is a summary board. Learn the Transaction record and satoshi units, then trace the sample rows and balance display into the screen. Separate sample values from values supplied by a network.
learning_objectives: Explain transaction shape, satoshi formatting, seeded records, and tab shell in plain language.
Trace export type Transaction in `src/data.ts` and explain the relevant behavior.
State and preserve this limit: Seed transactions and the receive address are placeholders; never send funds to them.
concepts: Transaction shape, satoshi formatting, seeded records, and tab shell
